verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an online tax filing and payment portal, but the evidence shows no rule engine, triggers, or event-driven actions. The closest item, post-dating a Webfile electronic check payment, is a one-off scheduled action set manually per filing, not a rule that fires on events. The open-data Socrata rail is read-only and offers no triggers or callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
